articles.summary: The limitations of traditional oncology trial design are well understood. Histology-based enrollment strategies, while operationally straightforward, frequently obscure the underlying molecular heterogeneity that governs therapeutic response. As a result, many late-stage failures may not reflect an absence of drug activity, but rather, an inability to resolve biologically distinct patient subsets within a single trial population.
articles.title: Genomics as a clinical trial enabler
